limitations: F is unpriced: it buys no wealth, orders nothing and reaches no publication path.
Samples are small. No significance test is run and no statistical conclusion is drawn; the distributions are printed side by side.
The control-arm candidate group is whatever the product actually produced, which on this corpus is nearly empty.
One corpus, one project. Nothing here generalises.
